content_sections.heading: How to Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates who meet the eligibility criteria can apply online for the NIT Calicut Various Posts Recruitment 2026. Applications must be submitted online on or before 25-09-2026. To apply directly, use the Apply Online link provided in the Important Links section. Alternatively, candidates may visit the official website of NIT Calicut to complete the application. Fill out the application form carefully with correct personal, educational, and contact details. Upload required documents such as photograph, signature, and certificates in the prescribed format. Pay the application fee online, if applicable. Review all details carefully before submitting the form. Take a printout or save a copy of the submitted application for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for NIT Calicut Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to apply online for the NIT Calicut Recruitment 2026 is 25 September 2026. Candidates are advised to submit their applications well before this date.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available for Team Lead / Junior Web Developer posts?
faq.answer: There are a total of 3 vacancies announced for the Team Lead and Junior Web Developer positions at NIT Calicut.

faq.question: Q3. What is the educational qualification required for these posts?
faq.answer: The educational qualifications vary by post, including Bachelor's or Master's degrees in Computer Science/Applications/IT, or ITI/Diploma in relevant fields.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary offered for the Team Lead and Junior Web Developer roles?
faq.answer: The salary for the Team Lead post is Rs. 80,000/- per month, and for the Junior Web Developer post, it is Rs. 25,000/- per month.

faq.question: Q5. What is the application fee for NIT Calicut Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The application fee varies by category. General/OBC candidates need to pay Rs. 1000 for Post 01 and Rs. 500 for Post 02. SC/ST and Women candidates have reduced fees.

faq.question: Q6. What is the selection process for these positions?
faq.answer: The selection process includes Online Application, Document Verification, Skill Test / Trade Test, and an Interview.

faq.question: Q7. Is this a contractual job?
faq.answer: Yes, the recruitment for these positions is on a contractual basis.

faq.question: Q8. Where can I find the official notification PDF?
faq.answer: The official notification PDF can be accessed through the "Important Links" section of this article by clicking the provided link.

faq.question: Q9. What is the official website of NIT Calicut?
faq.answer: The official website of the National Institute of Technology Calicut is www.nitc.ac.in.

faq.question: Q10. Can candidates from outside Kerala apply?
faq.answer: The notification does not specify any state-wise restrictions, but it's advisable to check the official notification for any such details.
